name: parabolic_trough_loss_correlations
title: Parabolic-trough receiver and collector heat-loss correlations (Schott PTR70, Sopogy, Soltigua)
summary: Function library of the empirical heat-loss and efficiency correlations of the ThermoCycle solar absorber models: the Schott PTR70 receiver heat-loss correlation (NREL/TP-550-45633) with the vacuum, lost-vacuum, hydrogen and Sopogy Soponova coefficient records, the optical/thermal efficiency chain of the same receiver, and the Soltigua PTMx collector efficiency fit with its cubic longitudinal incidence-angle modifier; a demonstration program verifies them against the NREL test data, the Soltigua datasheet and an independent Python re-evaluation.

origin.course: correlations of F. Burkholder and C. Kutscher (NREL/TP-550-45633, May 2009) and of the Soltigua PTMx and Sopogy Soponova datasheets

verification.reference: independent Python re-evaluation of the same equations (throw-away script, deleted after the import); measured heat losses of the NREL PTR70 heat-loss test (NREL/TP-550-45633, Table 3); Soltigua PTMx datasheet REV03-04/2013 (K_L table and reference conditions); independent Soponova correlation of Quoilin et al. (LaboThapPy LTP-050)
verification.notes: 34 common variables with the Python re-evaluation, 0 differ at rtol = 1e-3 (maximum 4.6e-10 on HL_calc[5]). Against the NREL Table 3 measured values (T_amb = 23 degC, DNI = 0, v_wind = 0): deviations -13.5 to +3.8 W/m over the eleven test points of receiver #1, all within the +/-10 W/m uncertainty of the report except the 506 degC point (2.7 %, just above the 500 degC upper end of the parametric runs). Soltigua K_L within 0.003 of the datasheet table at 0-60 deg.

history.action: added (translation of ThermoCycle AbsSchottSopo/AbsSoltigua, card C-90)
